reason: The README describes a web-based note management application centered on creating, organizing, synchronizing, and exporting notes, with optional image handling, AI editing, and agent integrations.

summaries.zh: 一个支持多端同步、图片插入及 PNG、Markdown 和 HTML 导出的网页便签与知识管理工具。
summaries.en: A web-based note and knowledge management tool for organizing synchronized notes with image support and PNG, Markdown, and HTML export.

capabilities: Store and synchronize note data across devices
Import images and export notes as PNG, Markdown, or HTML
Expose an API and skill integrations for agent-driven note creation
Optionally send content to an external AI service for rewriting and proofreading
